As a result second team place went the way of our under17s/under15s while the under 13s also scored well headed by David Bates, Chris Beaver and that mighty nine year-old, Paul Graham.
James Venning added his weight to the under 17 team and with our regulars in action again it was another 2nd place with 3rd for the under 13s led home again by David Bates.

Our Under 13 team was again headed by David Bates and Paul Graham and if these lads and their team-mates can continue to apply themselves in future seasons the way they have this winter, then the Bels will have some fine runners moving up through the ranks.
Belgrave competed very well with David Bates giving the under 13s a good start. Likewise Steve Beaver in the under15s, where he was well supported by Robert Bignall.
